$comment: Declared tool artifacts scripts/build-payloads.sh stages onto the shelf that
GET /api/k8s/payload/{name} serves. A scenario asks for one by name in
cluster_posture.payloads; a name declared there but missing from the shelf
makes GET /api/k8s/bootstrap/{id} refuse with PAYLOAD_NOT_STAGED rather than
let a pod run the scenario without its tooling.
sha256 is a PIN. When set, a download whose digest differs fails the build —
a build must never bless a changed upstream. Leave it null to have the
builder print the computed digest for you to paste back in; the shelf then
records pinned:false and the inventory endpoint reports it.
Both entries below are deliberately left UNPINNED because both URLs are
moving targets (a branch tip and a 'latest' release). Pinning them would
guarantee a PAYLOAD_PIN_MISMATCH the next time upstream ships. For an
engagement that needs reproducibility, repoint the url at a release TAG and
paste the digest the builder prints into sha256 — then the build refuses a
changed artifact instead of quietly staging it.
